rows.said: Achha, aur corner woh point hai na jahan edges milte hain?
rows.heard: अच्छा, और कॉर्नर वो पॉइंट है ना जहाँ एजेस मिलते हैं।
rows.reply: Haan, corner woh point hai jahan edges milte hain. Cube ke har corner par clay ki goli lagegi. Sticks edges hain aur goliyan corners. Kitni sticks aur kitni goliyan chahiye?

rows.said: Mujhe nahi pata, ek baar aur batao na.
rows.heard: मुझे नहीं पता। एक बार और बताओ ना।
rows.reply: Koi baat nahi, Aarav. Cube ko banaane ke liye har do corners ko jodne wali sticks gino; phir clay ki goliyan gino. Dabbe pe ungli wahan chalao jahan do faces milte hain. Woh line face hai, edge hai, ya corner?
